1.text: Labani azinduka kare mu gitondo, asoma abuzukuru be n'abakobwa be, abasabira umugisha. Labani aragenda, asubira iwabo.

2.text: Yakobo akomeza urugendo, abamarayika b'Imana bahura na we.

3.text: Yakobo ababonye aravuga ati “Aba ni umutwe w'ingabo z'Imana.” Yita aho hantu Mahanayimu.

4.text: Yakobo atuma intumwa ngo zimubanzirize zijye kwa Esawu mwene se mu gihugu cy'i Seyiri, mu ishyamba rya Edomu.

5.text: Arabategeka ati “Muzabwire databuja Esawu muti ‘Umugaragu wawe Yakobo ngo yabanaga na Labani, ageza ubu.’

6.text: Kandi muti ‘Afite inka n'indogobe n'imikumbi n'abagaragu n'abaja. None adutumye kuza kubikubwira, databuja, kugira ngo akugirireho umugisha.’ ”

7.text: Izo ntumwa zisubira aho Yakobo ari, ziramubwira ziti “Twageze kuri mwene so Esawu, kandi araza kugusanganira, azanye n'abantu magana ane.”

8.text: Yakobo aratinya cyane ahagarika umutima, abantu bari kumwe na we n'imikumbi n'amashyo n'ingamiya, abigabanyamo imitwe ibiri ati

9.text: “Esawu yatungukira ku mutwe umwe akawurimbura, usigaye wakira.”

10.text: Kandi Yakobo arambaza ati “Mana ya sogokuru Aburahamu, Mana ya Data Isaka, Uwiteka, ntiwambwiye uti ‘Subira mu gihugu cyanyu no muri bene wanyu, nanjye nzakugirira neza’?

11.text: Ku mbabazi zose n'umurava wose wagiriye umugaragu wawe, sinari nkwiriye guhabwaho n'ibyoroheje hanyuma y'ibindi, kuko nambutse Yorodani iyi mfite inkoni nsa, none mpindutse imitwe ibiri.

12.text: Ndakwinginze, unkize mwene data Esawu, kuko mutinya ngo ataza akanyicana n'abana na ba nyina.

13.text: Nawe warambwiye uti ‘Sinzabura kukugirira neza, nzahwanya urubyaro rwawe n'umusenyi wo ku nyanja, utabarika.’ ”

14.text: Aharara iryo joro, yenda ku byo yari afite ngo abihe Esawu mwene se ho impano:

15.text: ihene z'abāgazi magana abiri, n'iz'amapfizi makumyabiri, n'intama z'abāgazi magana abiri, n'iz'amapfizi makumyabiri,

16.text: n'ingamiya z'ingore mirongo itatu n'imicanda yazo yonkaga, n'inka mirongo ine n'amapfizi cumi, n'indogobe z'ingore makumyabiri n'ibyana byazo cumi.

17.text: Abiha abagaragu be, umukumbi wose ukwawo arababwira ati “Nimunjye imbere, mujye mushyira intera hagati y'umukumbi n'undi.”

18.text: Abwira ugiye imbere ati “Esawu mwene data nimuhura, akakubaza ati ‘Uri uwa nde, kandi urajya he, kandi n'ibyo ushoreye ni ibya nde?’

19.text: Maze umubwire uti ‘Ni iby'umugaragu wawe Yakobo, ni impano uhawe databuja Esawu, kandi dore na we ari inyuma yacu.’ ”

20.text: Maze abitegeka n'uwa kabiri n'uwa gatatu, n'abakurikiye iyo mikumbi bose ati “Abe ari ko mubwira Esawu, nimumubona,

21.text: kandi muti ‘Dore n'umugaragu wawe Yakobo ari inyuma yacu.’ ” Kuko yibwiye ati “Ndamwuruza impano zingiye imbere, maze nyuma tubonane, ahari aranyemera.”

22.text: Nuko izo mpano zimujya imbere, ahararana iryo joro n'umutwe w'abantu be.

23.text: Abyuka muri iryo joro, ajyana n'abagore be bombi n'inshoreke ze zombi n'abana be uko ari cumi n'umwe, yambuka icyambu cya Yaboki.

24.text: Arabajyana, abambutsa uwo mugezi, yambutsa n'ibyo yari afite byose.

25.text: Yakobo asigarayo wenyine.Haza umugabo aramukiranya, bageza mu museke.

26.text: Abonye yuko atamutsinze, akora ku mutsi wo ku nyonga y'itako rye, umutsi wo ku nyonga y'itako rya Yakobo urareguka bagikirana.

27.text: Uwo mugabo aramubwira ati “Ndekura, kuko umuseke utambitse.”Aramusubiza ati “Sinkurekura utampaye umugisha.”

29.text: Aramubwira ati “Ntucyitwa Yakobo ukundi, ahubwo uzitwa Isirayeli, kuko wakiranije Imana n'abantu ukanesha.”

30.text: Yakobo aramubwira ati “Ndakwinginze, mbwira izina ryawe.”Aramubaza ati “Ni iki gitumye umbaza izina ryanjye?” Amuherayo umugisha.

31.text: Yakobo yita aho hantu Penuweli ati “Ndebesheje Imana amaso, sinapfa.”

32.text: Izuba rirasa akirenga Penuweli, acumbagizwa n'ikibero cye.

33.text: Ibyo ni byo bituma Abisirayeli batarya umutsi wo ku itako, uri ku kibero, na bugingo n'ubu, kuko wa mugabo yakoze ku mutsi wo ku nyonga y'itako rya Yakobo.
